ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows one 5×5 dot array in each of the four quadrants of the coordinate axes; the x-coordinates and y-coordinates of these points each take -7,-6,-5,-4,-3 or 3,4,5,6,7. Therefore G=S×S, where S={-7,-6,-5,-4,-3,3,4,5,6,7}. According to the specified lattice-vector enumeration: take one side vector of the square as u=(a,b), and take the perpendicular side vector as v=(-b,a). To avoid repetition, count only side vectors whose direction angle is in [0,90°), namely a>0,b≥0. If P,P+u,P+v,P+u+v are all in G, then a unique square is obtained. Let d=a+b. For a,b≥0, the numbers of placements in the x and y directions are the same, both equal to H(a,b)=#{s: s,s+a,s+b,s+a+b are all in S}, so this vector contributes H(a,b)^2. Side length at least 6 means a^2+b^2≥36. Since d=a+b, nonzero contributions only require d=6 to 14. For fixed d, the endpoints s and s+d must respectively be in the negative and positive 5-point blocks. Write s=-k, then k∈{3,...,7} and d-k∈{3,...,7}; at the same time a,b cannot fall in the interval [k-2,k+2] corresponding to the gap. Enumerating all vectors satisfying a>0,b≥0,a+b=d,a^2+b^2≥36 accordingly gives contribution sums by d: d=6 is 1, d=7 is 4, d=8 is 11, d=9 is 24, d=10 is 45, d=11 is 56, d=12 is 47, d=13 is 28, d=14 is 9. The total number is 1+4+11+24+45+56+47+28+9=225.

raw_record.question_text: The set $G$ is defined by the points $(x,y)$ with integer coordinates, $3\le |x|\le 7$, $3\le |y|\le 7$. How many squares of side at least $6$ have their four vertices in $G$?

method.method_draft: Use a lattice-vector enumeration. From the figure/text, identify the allowed coordinate set as S={-7,-6,-5,-4,-3,3,4,5,6,7}, so G=S×S, arranged as four 5 by 5 blocks. Enumerate every possible square by choosing an integer side vector u=(a,b) and its perpendicular vector v=(-b,a). Require a^2+b^2>=36 for side at least 6. For each such u, count all base points P=(x,y) in G for which P, P+u, P+v, and P+u+v all lie in G. To avoid overcounting, use one canonical orientation per square, for example only count side vectors u whose direction angle lies in a half-open interval of length 90 degrees, or equivalently divide the raw count of directed edge/base-point representations by 4. Summing these valid placements over all integer vectors gives 225 squares.
method.CoT_raw: 图像显示坐标轴的四个象限中各有一个 5×5 的点阵；这些点的横坐标和纵坐标都分别取 -7,-6,-5,-4,-3 或 3,4,5,6,7。因此 G=S×S，其中 S={-7,-6,-5,-4,-3,3,4,5,6,7}。按指定的 lattice-vector enumeration：取正方形一条边向量 u=(a,b)，并取垂直边向量 v=(-b,a)。为避免重复，只数方向角在 [0,90°) 的边向量，即 a>0,b≥0。若 P,P+u,P+v,P+u+v 都在 G，则得到一个唯一正方形。令 d=a+b。对 a,b≥0，x 与 y 两个方向的可放置数相同，均等于 H(a,b)=#{s: s,s+a,s+b,s+a+b 都在 S}，所以该向量贡献 H(a,b)^2。边长至少 6 即 a^2+b^2≥36。由于 d=a+b，非零贡献只需 d=6 到 14。对固定 d，端点 s 和 s+d 必须分别在负、正两个 5 点区块中。写 s=-k，则 k∈{3,...,7} 且 d-k∈{3,...,7}；同时 a,b 不能落在缺口对应的区间 [k-2,k+2]。据此枚举所有满足 a>0,b≥0,a+b=d,a^2+b^2≥36 的向量，得到按 d 的贡献和：d=6 为 1，d=7 为 4，d=8 为 11，d=9 为 24，d=10 为 45，d=11 为 56，d=12 为 47，d=13 为 28，d=14 为 9。总数为 1+4+11+24+45+56+47+28+9=225。
